name: Cron job
description: Adds a cron job class implementing the Registrable interface from rtcamp/wp-framework. The class schedules a wp-cron event in register_hooks() and binds its handler to the chosen action.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the cron class. Default 'Inc\Cron' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace to override.
Directory for the cron file. Default 'includes/Cron'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Cron'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Cron'.
Cron job slug, kebab- or snake-case, e.g. 'sync-feed'. Used to derive the hook name and class.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.
WordPress action hook name, snake_case, e.g. 'myplugin_sync_feed'. Used in wp_schedule_event() and add_action().
WP cron schedule key: hourly | twicedaily | daily | weekly.

wiring.description: Add the cron class to the Cron module so the framework Loader calls register_hooks() during boot. If the Cron module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Cron --kind=cron`.
